notes.title: Major Update! 100 Christmas Cats v2.0 available! Hints, Achievements, etc...
notes.notes:
[h1]Meow! Long time no see, it's been almost 2 months since the game and it's time for a big refresh![/h1]

[h3]First of all, we want to thank you! [/h3]
After all, this is our first game and bugs were inevitable. Thanks to you and your feedback, we have greatly improved the game and timed this major update to coincide with the release of our new game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2743080/100_Capitalist_Cats/?utm_source=ChristmasMajorUpdate]100 Capitalist Cats[/url] (which is available right now)
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2743080/100_Capitalist_Cats/?utm_source=ChristmasMajorUpdate


[h2]The 100 Christmas Cats v2.0 update is now available![/h2]
[h3]List of changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added hints!
[*] Added 100 new achievements
[*] Fixed problems with counting clicks on objects
[*] Added effects when clicking on the cat (confetti, sounds)
[*] Added effects when winning (confetti, sounds)
[*] Updated victory screen
[*] Updated icons
[*] Added useful links (bug report, etc.)
[*] Improved game running on non-standard aspect ratios
[*] Significantly improved performance
[*] Fixed problems with quitting the game
[*] Updated effects
[*] Removed all old achievements
[*] Removed leaderboards (old entries remain)
[/list]

[h2]Play now![/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2687190/100_Christmas_Cats/?utm_source=ChristmasMajorUpdate

notes.title: 🛠 Huge BugFix Update - Available
notes.notes:
[h1]First of all, we want to thank you for your feedback![/h1]
Thanks to you, we fixed small and large bugs that made our game worse

[h3]Short list of changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug with achievements that are given for passing levels
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented you from resetting progress
[*] Fixed a bug related to counting the total number of cats found and the "Find 100 Cats" achievement
[*] Fixed a critical bug that caused the game to crash
[*] Improved overall game performance
[*] Fixed an issue with cat hitboxes
[*] Fixed a problem with cursor size mismatch that could cause clicks on cats to not count
[*] Changed the criteria for getting the "Combo" achievement, now you need to find 3 cats instead of 5.
[*] Fixed a bug related to quitting the game
[*] Fixed bug related to non-standard screen resolutions
[/list]

[h3]If you know of any other bugs[/h3]
Let us know here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/2687190/discussions/0/4035850896215107500/


[h3]Play the Game[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2687190/100_Christmas_Cats/

notes.title: 🛠 Hot Fix: Exit from the Game
notes.notes: We fixed an issue where the game wouldn't close properly

notes.title: 🛠 Hot Fix: Cursor size + Cats size (NO Miss clicks)
notes.notes:
We have resized the cursor so your clicks are accurate.
The size of the area where you need to click to find the cat - increased
Now there should be no situations when clicking on the cat doesn't work.

notes.title: 🛠 Hot Fix: Optimization (NO HUGE LAGS)
notes.notes: We have significantly improved game optimization and fixed a critical bug

notes.title: Hot Fix: Resolution (Green Screen)
notes.notes:
We have temporarily resolved the issue with non-standard screen resolutions.
Now the game is forced to run in 16:9 aspect ratio

notes.title: Hot Fix: Achievement "Find 100 Cats"
notes.notes: We have fixed the counting of found cats

notes.title: Hot Fix: Achievements
notes.notes: We have fixed the giving of achievements for completing levels

notes.title: Hot Fix: Achievements v2
notes.notes: We have fixed the giving of achievements for Total Found cats
